intro: Smart, stylish, and seriously relaxing—our Swing recliner wraps you in comfort with tech-driven ease. With storage, power, and 360° freedom, it's all-in-one bliss.

features.title: Touch to recline
features.text: Effortlessly shift from upright to reclined with just a button—smooth, quiet, and fully adjustable for your perfect comfort zone.

features.title: Stay powered up
features.text: Built-in USB port keeps your devices charged while you relax, stream, or scroll—because comfort should never unplug you.

features.title: Hidden storage, handy access
features.text: A clever storage space under the armrest gives you a spot for remotes, books, or chargers—right within reach, but out of sight.

features.title: Cradling lumbar support
features.text: Designed to embrace your lower back, the plush lumbar zone eases pressure and supports you where you need it most.

features.title: Bucketed comfort
features.text: The seat is sculpted for a natural fit, providing a cocoon-like feel with just the right bounce and softness.

features.title: Swivel in style
features.text: With a black powder coated base that offers a 360° swivel and rocking motion, you can turn, sway, and settle in your perfect position—effortlessly.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Swing Motorised 1-Seater Fabric Recliner
